items.title: OnEMI Technology rises 5% after Q2FY27 profit doubles to ₹125 crore
items.description: For the September quarter, OnEMI Technology Solutions reported a PAT of ₹125.12 crore, up 100 per cent Y-o-Y. The firm had earned a profit of ₹62.4 crore in the same quarter a yea ago.

items.title: eClerx Services shares plunge 13% post company's second-quarter results
items.description: eClerx Services reported an 18.3 per cent year-on-year increase in operating revenue to ₹1,188.7 crore in Q2 FY27, compared with ₹1,004.9 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.

items.description: Jefferies, which assigned a 'buy' call to NSE with a target price of ₹2,085, expects a 17 per cent upside from the last closing price of ₹1,770.
